diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index bd617b7..ad32a09 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 # fetchit
 
-Fetch JSON from a URL and print it.
+Fetch JSON from a URL and print it, or write it to a file with `--out`.
 
     fetchit https://api.example.com/items --timeout 5
+
+    fetchit https://api.example.com/items --out result.json
diff --git a/fetchit/cli.py b/fetchit/cli.py
index ddbc0bd..3c1e704 100644
--- a/fetchit/cli.py
+++ b/fetchit/cli.py
@@ -9,13 +9,23 @@ def main(argv=None) -> int:
     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="fetchit")
     ap.add_argument("url")
     ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10.0)
+    ap.add_argument("--out", help="write the JSON to this file instead of printing it")
     a = ap.parse_args(argv)
     try:
         data = fetch_json(a.url, timeout=a.timeout)
     except FetchError as e:
         print(e, file=sys.stderr)
         return 1
-    print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
+    text = json.dumps(data, indent=2)
+    if a.out:
+        try:
+            with open(a.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                f.write(text + "\n")
+        except OSError as e:
+            print(e, file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+    else:
+        print(text)
     return 0
